title: BAAJA vs. Local Opposition to AI, Transmission and Clean Energy

meta.summary:
Data centers have tapped into ─ and become emblematic of ─ deep-seated social fears and anxieties, and opposition to them is driving policy at the local, state, federal and international levels, writes Livewire columnist K Kaufmann. 
 The post  BAAJA vs. Local Opposition to AI, Transmission and Clean Energy  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
